meta-runner.name: Generate License Files
meta-runner.description: Generate the third-party license files of a component version through the license service (report only)

param.name: COMPONENT_NAME
param.spec: text description='Component name in the components registry' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_SERVICE_URL
param.spec: text description='License service base URL' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_OUTPUT_DIR
param.spec: text description='Directory for the report and the license files, published as build artifacts' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_RUNNER_JAVA_HOME
param.spec: text description='JDK 25 home the runner runs on' validationMode='not_empty' display='normal'

param.name: LICENSE_RUNNER_ARGS
param.spec: text description='Extra license-runner options, e.g. --timeout PT45M' display='normal'
